title: MS
description: In-character message as broadcast by the server, with the pair's data filled in.

preanim.description: Preanimation played before the emote; empty or `-` for none.

emote.description: Emote name; the client plays its `(b)` talking and `(a)` idle variants.

sfx_name.description: Sound effect to play; `1`, `0` or empty for none.

emote_modifier.description: Whether the preanim plays and whether the zoom background is used.

sfx_delay.description: Delay before `sfx_name` plays, in ticks of 40 ms.

shout_modifier.description: Shout bubble (objection etc.) shown before the message.

evidence_id.description: 1-based index of the evidence item to present; 0 for none.

realization.description: Flash the screen and play the realization sound.

showname.description: Name shown in the chatbox; empty uses the character's default showname.

paired_charid.description: Paired character's ID, or -1 for no pair.

paired_order.description: Z-order of the paired character relative to the speaker; 0 renders behind (the default), 1 in front. Packed onto paired_charid as `<id>^1` when 1, the bare `<id>` otherwise.

offset.description: Speaker's horizontal and vertical offset, in percent of the viewport.

paired_offset.description: Paired character's offset; empty on the wire when there is no pair.

noninterrupting_preanim.description: Show the message while the preanim plays instead of after it.

frames_shake.description: Frame-triggered screenshakes from char.ini: one `^`-terminated segment per emote (preanim, `(b)`, `(a)`), each `emote|frame=value|...`.

frames_realization.description: Frame-triggered realization flashes, in the `frames_shake` format.

frames_sfx.description: Frame-triggered sound effects, in the `frames_shake` format.

additive.description: Append the message to the previous one instead of replacing it.

effect.description: Screen-effect overlay request, packed on the wire as `name|folder|sound` (see EFFECTS.md).
